name: @forest-rs/layerstack-demo
description: A scene editor over @forest-rs/layerstack: open, explain, edit, edit an asset through its reference, switch a variant, define and retype, rename, undo, save and reopen, mute an asset, in plain DOM, with a three.js viewport drawn from the stage's reads through @forest-rs/layerstack_stagehand's buffers.
